jobs.description:
Director, Selection Operational Excellence
About Coupang
Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the moment they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door.
Powered by an end-to-end e-commerce and logistics network and a culture of customer obsession, Coupang has redefined tradeoffs between speed, selection, and price. We provide fast delivery on millions of items, including fresh groceries, delivered within hours nationwide, 365 days a year.
South Korea represents one of the most dynamic and fast-growing e-commerce markets globally, and Coupang continues to lead through innovation and operational excellence.
Role Overview
As Director of Selection Operational Excellence, you will lead the strategy and execution of Coupang’s selection identification and onboarding operations. This role sits at the forefront of the customer experience—defining what products we should sell and ensuring we deliver the most relevant, high-demand, and differentiated selection.
You will own a multi-year roadmap, drive data-backed decision making, and build scalable, tech-enabled processes. This is a highly cross-functional leadership role requiring strong business judgment, deep analytical thinking, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
What You Will Do
Selection Strategy & Identification
Lead selection identification across multiple retail categories (e.g., Electronics, Home, Consumables, Baby, Sports).
Identify non-obvious selection gaps, including variants, bundles, niche brands, and emerging customer demand.
Develop data-driven perspectives leveraging customer signals, reviews, trends, and market insights.
Translate insights into actionable strategies to improve selection coverage and relevance.
Strategic Leadership
Define and execute a 2–3 year roadmap for selection planning and onboarding.
Partner with Category, Product, Engineering, and Catalog teams to accelerate selection expansion.
Align selection strategy with customer experience and broader business goals.
Operational Excellence
Design and scale SOPs, SLAs, and quality frameworks to ensure consistent and efficient execution.
Introduce automation, tooling, and process improvements to reduce defects and manual effort.
Establish feedback loops, audits, and continuous improvement mechanisms.
Data-Driven Execution
Analyze internal metrics and external market trends to identify opportunities and root causes.
Drive initiatives that improve catalog quality, onboarding speed, and operational efficiency.
Ensure selection decisions are tied to commercial outcomes and customer impact.
Stakeholder Management
Act as a key influencer across teams, using data-backed insights to challenge assumptions and drive alignment.
Present recommendations and strategies clearly and effectively to senior leadership.
Team Leadership
Build and lead a high-performing organization.
Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Mentor leaders and develop strong succession pipelines.
Basic Qualifications
10+ years of experience in operations, strategy, e-commerce, retail, or catalog/selection management.
Proven experience leading large teams and complex cross-functional initiatives.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset.
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvements and measurable business impact.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in selection or catalog operations, including SOP/SLA design and process optimization.
Familiarity with operational excellence frameworks (e.g., defect detection, feedback loops, automation).
Knowledge of AI/ML applications in selection planning or catalog optimization.
Experience in global or regional e-commerce environments.
Bilingual proficiency in Korean and English preferred.
Leadership Qualities
Customer Obsession:
Deep commitment to improving customer experience through better selection.
Ownership:
Takes end-to-end accountability for strategy and execution.
Dive Deep:
Ability to uncover root causes and solve complex problems.
Invent & Simplify:
Drives scalable solutions through innovation and automation.
Bias for Action:
Operates effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
Why This Role Matters
This role directly impacts Coupang’s growth and customer experience by ensuring we offer the most relevant selection at scale. You will shape how we identify opportunities, influence business decisions, and build the future of selection strategy at Coupang.

Application Review - Phone Interview - Onsite (or Virtual Onsite) Interview – Offer
The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary depending on the role and may change due to scheduling or other circumstances.
Interview schedules and results will be communicated via the email address provided at the time of application.
Things to Consider

Coupang reserves the right to rescind an offer of employment if a candidate is found to have provided false information during the application process.
Coupang is committed to equal opportunity employment and does not discriminate against applicants based on disability or veteran status.
Job titles and responsibilities may be adjusted based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. This will be communicated prior to the offer stage.
Privacy Notice
Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang in accordance with the Application Privacy Notice.
For more details, please visit: https://www.coupang.jobs/en/privacy-policy/
Document Return Policy

jobs.description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) brings new services and features to customers at an unprecedented cadence — more than 3,000 launches a year, and accelerating as the AI landscape evolves. Behind that velocity is the Launch Operations team, which owns the process that governs the lifecycle of bringing every AWS capability to customers, from intake through customer availability. We turn AWS’s innovation velocity into a durable Marketing advantage: driving operational scale so service teams and stakeholders can focus on innovation, and improving signal-to-noise so the most important news reaches customers and enables field sales and partner teams to engage around the launches that matter most. We are looking for a Program Manager to help run the programs that make this possible. Working closely with senior program managers and stakeholders, you will help keep launches moving on time and at a high quality bar — coordinating across product managers, marketing, engineering, security, legal, and field teams, tracking deliverables, and surfacing risks early. This is a role for someone who is organized, resourceful, and eager to grow in a high-visibility, cross-functional environment where the details matter and the scale is significant. You will learn the launch process end to end, and as you do, you will spot where manual coordination slows launches down and help implement the improvements that make the next cycle smoother. Key job responsibilities 1. Support the end-to-end launch operations program including tracking milestones and deliverables, maintaining schedules, and surfacing risks across multiple concurrent launches. 2. Coordinate with product managers, marketing, engineering, security, legal, and field teams to keep launches moving from intake to customer availability and help remove blockers. 3. Help identify process gaps in how launches move through the pipeline and contribute to improvements that raise quality and reduce cycle time. 4. Maintain program dashboards and status reporting, ensuring stakeholders have accurate, timely visibility into launch progress. 5. Track program metrics and help improve signal-to-noise so the most important launches are elevated to customers. 6. Apply generative AI tools including Amazon Quick to streamline documentation, status reporting, and program analysis. A day in the life You start your morning reviewing the launch pipeline and flagging any launches at risk of slipping, then follow up with the relevant task owners to keep them on track. Mid-morning, you join a working session with product and marketing partners to walk through upcoming launches and capture next steps. After lunch, you update the program dashboard and pull together a status summary for the team, highlighting progress and any open items that need attention. Between meetings, you look for small ways to remove friction in the intake process often using generative AI tooling to speed up the documentation and reporting that used to take up much of your day. About the team The AWS Lifecycle Marketing team shapes how the world’s leading cloud and AI portfolio reaches customers. We orchestrate how AWS launches are integrated with Marketing planning, how lifecycle changes are managed responsibly, and how the portfolio is represented across shared surfaces and priority moments — removing complexity, increasing visibility, and ensuring Marketing can act with the coordination, speed, and strategic focus the portfolio requires. Launch Operations is the connective tissue between AWS Service Engineering and AWS Marketing, and this role is a great entry point into a multi-year transformation from manual, relationship-driven coordination to scalable, data-driven platforms. If you want to work on programs that shape how millions of customers experience AWS innovation, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description: You will own the operational enablement functions that allow ISOC (Intervention Security Operations Center) international monitoring operations to run at scale across regulated jurisdictions. This role is responsible for regulatory compliance management, technology integration coordination, vendor contract management, training and certification programs, and the standard operating procedures that ensure consistent execution regardless of location or operator. You are the person who builds the systems and frameworks that the rest of the team operates within. This is not an operations execution role. You will not manage shifts or handle alerts. You will build the compliance backbone, negotiate vendor agreements, coordinate platform deployments, develop training curricula, and maintain the audit and governance frameworks that keep operations legally sound and operationally excellent. You enable the people who execute by giving them the tools, training, standards, and contracts they need to perform. Key job responsibilities ● Own regulatory and compliance management for ISOC monitoring operations across all international jurisdictions, ensuring operations meet data protection, surveillance, and privacy requirements ● Navigate legal frameworks for remote monitoring, cross-border data transfer, and alert handling, partnering with legal counsel to translate regulatory requirements into operational procedures ● Manage vendor contracts for third party monitoring operators, including agreement negotiation, SLA definition, performance measurement, cost optimization, and renewal planning ● Coordinate technology integration across the monitoring platform, including new system deployments, platform standardization, configuration management, and tool selection ● Develop and maintain the training and certification program for ISOC analysts, including onboarding curricula, recurring proficiency assessments, and specialized skill development for new use cases ● Own the standard operating procedure (SOP) library, ensuring procedures remain current with regulatory changes, technology updates, and lessons learned from operational incidents ● Build and maintain the audit and compliance framework, including internal assessment schedules, evidence collection, regulatory reporting, and remediation tracking ● Drive operational excellence initiatives: process improvement, efficiency analysis, quality management, and standardization across international control room operations ● Support the EU Country Lead and broader ISOC leadership with operational enablement, removing barriers and providing the compliance, technology, and vendor infrastructure needed for growth A day in the life Your morning starts with reviewing a regulatory update from counsel on a pending change to monitoring consent requirements in one of your operating jurisdictions. You assess the operational impact, draft the Standard Operating Procedure revision needed, and flag the training update required for affected analysts. Mid-morning, you join a vendor performance review call to discuss compliance, staffing shortfalls, and contract renewal terms for one of your third party operator agreements. You spend part of your day working on the technology integration roadmap: coordinating with the platform team on a new system deployment timeline, validating that data handling configurations meet jurisdictional requirements, and updating the integration checklist for the operations team. After lunch, you review the latest analyst certification results from the quarterly assessment cycle, identify skill gaps, and adjust the training program accordingly. You close the day updating the compliance tracker for an upcoming audit and preparing a cost optimization proposal for the next vendor negotiation cycle. About the team ISOC (Intervention Security Operations Center) is Amazon's centralized, alert-driven security intervention capability within the Security Operations Group. Operating 24/7 control rooms across multiple global locations, ISOC receives technology-generated signals, validates threats in real time, and coordinates the appropriate response function. ISOC sits within SOG under Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) and is positioned within the security lifecycle model as the team that owns the Intervention function. The international operations span multiple countries and regulatory environments, requiring robust compliance frameworks, standardized procedures, and coordinated enablement functions to maintain operational consistency at scale. This role provides that enablement layer, ensuring that operations teams have the regulatory clearance, technology platforms, trained workforce, and vendor support they need to deliver.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Claude App Infrastructure owns the reliability, experience, and agentic capabilities of claude.ai. We're the platform team for Anthropic's flagship consumer product, responsible for the serving architecture that keeps Claude available at scale, the conversation experience, and the infrastructure that lets every product team at Anthropic ship into claude.ai safely and fast. When the product grows at hyper scale, we're the team that makes sure it feels the same or better.
Beyond the foundation, we're building the agentic layer that turns claude.ai from a chat surface into an execution surface: task execution, personalization, browser use, and server-side tools. This is where the next generation of the product gets built: the primitives that let Claude act in the world, not just respond. We believe reliability and velocity are the same problem, and our job is to build the systems that make both inevitable.

Design and build sandboxed compute environments where Claude can safely execute code, access tools, and interact with external services
Build state management systems for long-running agent tasks, handling checkpoints, recovery, and resumption across failures
Develop authentication and authorization frameworks for delegated access, so Claude can act on behalf of users securely
